description: OnSSET, published by OnSSET contributors, supports spatial electrification scenarios using settlement GIS data and calibrated starting conditions. Coverage: Inputs are GIS attributes for individual settlements and calibrated starting-year information; scenario runs may use multiple time steps. No fixed national case or observation period is implied. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence: MIT, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Numerical correctness and compatibility have not been independently tested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
